card.name: Linking word before a peel/lift action
card.fires_on: A small linking word or comma that ends a clause and comes right before a verb like peel, pull back, or whip back. It shows up in handling instructions and in descriptions of physical objects.

modes.label: Instruction clause break
modes.description: A comma or 'by' or 'and' after a handling or checking step, just before the next action verb.
